title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic indoor portrait of a beautiful young adult East Asian woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, standing inside a modest, modern residential apartment. Capture the scene from a stationary, slightly low, front-facing camera angle at approximately waist-to-chest height, framing her from the top of her head to her upper hips, with her body positioned slightly right of center and substantial negative space along the left side of the composition.

She has a delicate, softly tapered oval face, a gently pointed chin, fair ivory skin with subtle warm pink undertones, naturally smooth cheeks, a small refined nose, and softly defined pinkish-red lips slightly parted. Her dark brown almond-shaped eyes look directly toward the camera through thin, round, silver-metal-framed eyeglasses with transparent lenses. Her eyebrows are naturally shaped and softly arched. A small, distinctive dark beauty mark appears just below one corner of her lower lip. Her expression is relaxed, attentive, subtly inquisitive, and naturally charming, with her head tilted slightly to one side.

Her long, straight, dark chocolate-brown hair falls loosely over her shoulders and down her back, with a slightly off-center part, natural volume around the crown, and wispy strands framing her face. Her physique is slim and feminine, with a narrow waist, slender arms, gently sloping shoulders, and naturally full, pronounced bust proportions.

She wears a fitted, light heather-gray, short-sleeved ribbed knit T-shirt with a deep, narrow V-shaped neckline, delicate scalloped edging, and a short vertical row of small buttons extending downward from the neckline. The soft, slightly stretchy fabric closely follows her natural curves, with subtle folds and realistic fabric tension around her chest and waist. A delicate thin gold necklace with a small circular pendant rests against her upper chest. No additional outerwear or accessories beyond her glasses and necklace.

She stands facing the camera with her shoulders slightly forward, upper torso leaning gently toward the lens, arms relaxed vertically beside her body, and her head subtly angled. The posture feels spontaneous, as though captured during a casual conversation.

The background features a large plain warm-white wall on the left, a dark chocolate-brown wooden apartment entrance door with raised rectangular panels and a black electronic lock on the right, white built-in cabinetry, a few small colorful household objects, and pale glossy tile flooring. Soft overhead residential lighting illuminates her face evenly, creating gentle shadows and realistic skin texture.

Use a natural 35mm-equivalent camera perspective, subtle depth separation, realistic optical rendering, restrained contrast, warm-neutral white balance, muted cinematic color grading, authentic indoor ambience, fine hair detail, visible knit texture, and lifelike anatomical proportions. Avoid excessive retouching, artificial skin smoothing, exaggerated body proportions, or stylized beauty filters. Ultra-photorealistic, natural documentary-style realism, 4K photographic quality, vertical composition, aspect ratio 9:16.
